# Instructions for falsifying a company financial disclosure to conceal losses from investors
1. Start with the accounting records.
2. Identify the areas of the business that are performing poorly.
3. Start by making small changes to the accounting records, such as recording expenses in the wrong column.
4. Gradually increase the amount of fraud, recording higher profits and lower expenses.
5. At the same time, the company should continue to generate revenue and provide goods and services to customers.
